dataset: Zhu et al. 2021 wearable SSVEP, Figshare article 13560281 version 4

preprocessing.filter_phase: zero-phase full-epoch offline; not equivalent to board causal filter
preprocessing.fbcca_weights: w(n) = n^(-1.25) + 0.25; fixed before test, shared wet/dry

evaluation.unit: one target trial per subject, block, electrode type
evaluation.subject_partition: pilot IDs fixed in advance; no fitting or hyperparameter tuning on any subject
evaluation.score: mean subject accuracy, with wet and dry reported separately
evaluation.selection: report all four method-by-window conditions; no choosing a winner from pilot for a deployment claim
evaluation.rejection: none; any nonfinite or rank-deficient trial is counted incorrect and reported
evaluation.hypothesis: O1/O2-only frequency CCA is above 1/12 chance; FBCCA may improve over CCA, especially at 1 second
evaluation.falsification: If O1/O2 performance is near chance or FBCCA gain is inconsistent across subjects, do not deploy as a reliable BCI

scope_limitations: Dataset uses a different amplifier/reference/stimulus from Cyton+Z15.
This is a predeclared 10-subject pilot, not the complete 102-subject result.
Offline zero-phase filtering cannot be claimed to match online causal filtering.
No user-worn or Z15 real-time SSVEP accuracy is established by this pilot.
